walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the CCEA A-Level Computer Science specification.

Software Engineering appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Software Engineering in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Software Engineering.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
